summary: This topic outlines the process of creating a new timetable by defining lecture numbers, setting precise start and end times for each lecture period, and incorporating breaks into the daily schedule.
steps: Select the 'Class' for which the timetable is being created.
Enter the 'Start Time' for the lecture (e.g., 8:00 a.m.).
Enter the 'End Time' for the lecture (e.g., 8:40 a.m.).
To add more lectures, click 'Add more lectures'; the start time for the next lecture will automatically populate based on the previous lecture's end time.
To define a break, toggle the 'Break' option for a specific lecture slot and set its duration.
Click 'Save Schedule' once all lecture and break timings for the day are defined.
business_rules: Start and end times precisely define the duration of each lecture or break period.
important_notes: All lecture timings and breaks for the entire day must be added to complete the schedule.
